# Stickyy 1.1.1
## Wider Mac compatibility
- Stickyy now supports macOS 14 and later on both Apple silicon and Intel Macs. - Liquid Glass remains available on macOS 26 and later; earlier systems use Stickyy's original minimal material appearance. - Fixed a packaging-signature mismatch that could stop the downloaded app from launching after installation.
## A clearer welcome
- The welcome tour now includes an interactive preview of the floating note.
## Distribution
- Downloads and in-app update archives are now served directly from the Stickyy website.
